## Posted terms
Title: Clinical AI Integration Lead
Company: a health-technology company (~300 staff), Series C
Location: Hybrid, Boston MA — 2 days onsite
Type: Full time
Salary: $140,000 - $155,000

## Job description (as posted)

**About the role**
Our platform sits between hospital systems and the clinicians who use them. We are hiring a
Clinical AI Integration Lead to own both halves of that: the interfaces that move patient
data in and out of partner health systems, and the models that turn clinical notes into
structured summaries our users can act on.

**Responsibilities**
- Build and maintain HL7 v2 and FHIR interfaces to partner health systems, including Epic
  and Cerner installations, and own the interface engine configuration
- Troubleshoot production interface failures with hospital IT counterparts, including
  after-hours escalations when a feed breaks
- Manage the onboarding of new health-system partners end to end: mapping, testing, go-live
- Train, evaluate and deploy clinical NLP models that extract structured findings from free
  text notes, and own model performance in production
- Design the evaluation methodology for clinical extraction quality, including clinician
  adjudication of disagreements
- Keep model behaviour within our regulatory posture and support evidence for audits

**Required**
- 5+ years working with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7 v2, FHIR), and hands-on
  experience with an interface engine such as Mirth, Rhapsody or Cloverleaf
- Direct experience integrating with Epic or Cerner in a production hospital environment
- Experience training and deploying NLP or LLM-based models on clinical text, with
  measurable accuracy targets
- Python, and comfort owning a model in production rather than handing it off
- Able to hold a technical conversation with hospital IT and with clinicians

**Nice to have**
- Prior work in a regulated clinical setting
- Familiarity with de-identification and PHI handling requirements
- Experience with clinician-in-the-loop evaluation workflows
